elements.text: Temporal requirement: the relevant disposition occurred on or after 9 June 1952.
binding_requirements: The date must concern the same disposition transaction or arrangement used for the disposition element.

elements.text: Disposition requirement: the tenant's conduct fits subletting, assignment, or otherwise parting with possession, with the retained-possession qualification applied to the third route.
binding_requirements: Tests combined for a selected route must concern the same tenant, relevant other person, arrangement, and whole or part of the premises.
For subletting, the relationship, transfer of interest, rent, and right to possession must concern the same purported subtenancy.
For parting with possession, divestment and any retained legal possession or concurrent use must concern the same arrangement and same part of the premises.

elements.text: Premises-scope requirement: the disposition concerns the whole or any part of the premises.
binding_requirements: The premises or part must be the same premises or part used for the selected disposition route and written-consent inquiry.

elements.text: Written-consent requirement: the tenant did not obtain the landlord's consent in writing for the relevant disposition.
binding_requirements: The consent inquiry must concern the same disposition and the same whole or part of the premises as the other elements.
